thread:
aline: Quick heads-up — I pushed a docs PR for on‑prem smoke tests and a tiny example snippet for air‑gapped installs. Can someone QA the checklist and the `pkcs11` example? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421 :eyes:
sam: On it. Quick skim — looks good. Can you include the minimal env var example for HSM so customers know what to export before running the installer? e.g. `export PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so`
aline: Yup, added an `env` subsection. Also added an `--airgap` example that uses the offline bundle. Snippet: ```sh
./redwood-installer --profile sealed-site --airgap \n  --bundle ./redwood-offline-2027-03.tar.gz \n  --hsm-plugin pkcs11
```
michelle: I ran the smoke checklist in the sealed lab (with the new snippet). Hit an NTP issue during node bootstrap — installer waits on time sync and then times out. Minimal log: `ERR time sync failed: ntp: unreachable`
raj: For sealed labs we usually need to set `--allow-ntp-skip` or ensure chronyd is running in bootstrap env. Try `systemctl restart chronyd && chronyc sources` on the node. Also confirm /etc/chrony.conf has the correct pool entries for your isolated network.
aline: Thx — added a troubleshooting note and an explicit step: `systemctl enable --now chronyd` before running installer. Also included acceptance criteria: `installer exit code 0`, `redwood-agent service active`, `pkcs11-tool --list-objects` returns token.
sam: Can you also add a checksum verification step for the offline bundle (users often forget)? Example: `sha256sum redwood-offline-2027-03.tar.gz | grep <EXPECTED_HASH>` — add where the bundle download is referenced.
aline: Done. Added a short `verify` subsection with the sha256 snippet and a link to our checksum page: https://docs.redwood.com/airgap/checksums
docs-bot: New commit pushed to docs PR 421 by aline — preview available: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference/internal/421
michelle: Re-ran smoke tests after chrony fix + checksum verify — all green except one minor permission on /var/lib/redwood (we need the installer to create the dir if absent). Log: `ERR permission denied: mkdir /var/lib/redwood`
raj: That should be `mkdir -p /var/lib/redwood && chown redwood:redwood /var/lib/redwood` in the preflight steps. Can we add that to the install notes and to the example systemd unit snippet?
aline: Added preflight command and a one-liner systemd snippet to the PR. Also called out that SELinux can cause similar failures and included `setenforce 0` as a troubleshooting hint (marked clearly as not for prod).
sam: Looks solid. Added one nit about wording. Acceptance criteria updated to include `pkcs11 token accessible` and `agent can reach control-plane over VPC peering port 8443`
aline: Updated per nits, included the VPC port matrix link and small diagram. Ready to merge once one more +1.
michelle: +1 from QA — verified steps on sealed lab and added a short note about testdata used (hsm test token label: REDWOOD_TEST).
build-bot: Docs preview build succeeded for PR 421 — checks: linters passed, links ok. :white_check_mark:
aline: Thanks all — merging in 10m unless anyone objects. I'll follow up with a short release note to the migrations channel.
